description: The HTML drafts slides of a slide deck were made from, to change them and save them again with saveReportSlides under the same ids. A slide changed in Rollstack since its draft was saved, by a person in the editor or by Rollstack's agent, answers the draft as it was saved with changedInRollstack, the list of what was changed since: make every one of those changes in the draft first, so the work done there is kept, then make your own. A slide made by hand in the editor has no draft (html is null): a draft sent under its id rewrites the whole slide, dropping what was done there, so look at it with getReportSlideImages and ask the user first. At most 10 slides a call.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

slideIds.description: The slides whose drafts to read, by their `id` from `getReportContent` or a reply's `changedSlideIds`, hidden ones included. Ids that are not slides of the report are ignored. 1 to 10 ids: repeat the parameter for each one, as in `?slideIds=a&slideIds=b`.

name: getReportSlideHtml
title: Get slide drafts
